title: Problems with Shapley-value-based explanations as feature importance measures
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct any benchmarks related to faith or religion.
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention religion, faith, or religious groups. Its focus is a mathematical and philosophical critique of Shapley-value-based explainability methods in machine learning.
